# Pabawi

> Pabawi is a unified web interface for infrastructure management, command execution, and VM provisioning — integrating Puppet, Bolt, Ansible, SSH, Proxmox, AWS, Azure, and more.

## Overview

Pabawi is an open-source (Apache 2.0) command-and-control web UI for classic infrastructure. It aggregates inventory from multiple sources (Bolt, PuppetDB, Ansible, SSH, Proxmox, AWS, Azure), provides real-time remote execution with streaming output, and offers deep Puppet integration (reports, catalogs, Hiera browser). Current version: v1.2.0.

## Core Capabilities

- Multi-source inventory aggregation (Bolt, PuppetDB, Ansible, SSH, Proxmox, AWS, Azure)
- Ad-hoc command execution and Bolt task execution on remote nodes
- Ansible playbook execution
- Package management across infrastructure
- Execution history with re-execution support
- Puppet reports with metrics, resource changes, and run history
- Catalog inspection with cross-environment diff
- Hiera data browser with key usage analysis
- Real-time streaming output (SSE) for command/task execution
- RBAC authentication with role-based permissions
- Proxmox VM/LXC provisioning
- AWS EC2 instance management
- Azure VM lifecycle management
- Built-in MCP server for AI/LLM integration (read-only, RBAC-gated)
- Expert mode with full command lines and debug output
- Graceful degradation when individual integrations are unavailable

## Target Users

Infrastructure engineers and DevOps teams managing servers with Puppet/OpenVox, Bolt, Ansible, and SSH. Supports both Puppet Enterprise and Open Source Puppet/OpenVox. Also suitable for homelabbers using SSH-only mode.

## Tech Stack

- Backend: Node.js, Express, TypeScript, SQLite/PostgreSQL
- Frontend: Svelte 5, Vite, TailwindCSS
- Deployment: Docker (multi-arch), single-container or bare-metal
- Authentication: JWT with RBAC
- Plugin architecture for all integrations
